title: The adic completion of a module along a finitely generated ideal is complete, with quotients M/I^nM
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ a finitely generated ideal and $M$ an $A$-module. Let $M^\wedge=\varprojlim_nM/I^nM$ (compatible sequences, componentwise $A$-module structure) with projections $p_n:M^\wedge\to M/I^nM$, $(x_k)_k\mapsto x_n$. Then (1) $M^\wedge$ is $I$-adically complete as an $A$-module: the canonical map $M^\wedge\to\varprojlim_nM^\wedge/I^nM^\wedge$ is bijective; in particular $\bigcap_{n\ge1}I^nM^\wedge=0$; (2) for every $n\ge1$, $p_n$ is surjective with kernel $I^nM^\wedge$ (the $A$-submodule generated by the $ay$, $a\in I^n$, $y\in M^\wedge$), so $p_n$ induces an $A$-linear isomorphism $M^\wedge/I^nM^\wedge\cong M/I^nM$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 05GG (lemma-hathat-finitely-generated, line 22645), parts (1) and (2) for an arbitrary module M
